name: Royal Courier Public Service Relationships

entity_scope.separate_entity_notice: Royal Courier Inc. and Royal Expediting Inc. are separate legal entities.

purpose: Public machine-readable examples of service attributes and service categories that may be relevant together for certain shipment scenarios.
interpretation: Relationships are descriptive associations only. They are not dispatch rules, pricing rules, routing logic, acceptance criteria, or guarantees of service availability.
limitations: Does not expose proprietary dispatch logic.
Does not expose pricing logic, margins, or customer-specific procedures.
Does not represent real-time capacity or shipment acceptance.
Does not define mandatory service combinations.
Does not replace shipment-specific quote or dispatch review.

relationships.public_context: Urgent commercial freight may use dedicated or exclusive-use transportation when shipment timing or handling requirements call for a dedicated vehicle path.
Palletized or heavier commercial shipments may involve a straight truck together with liftgate and pallet-jack support when loading-dock access is unavailable or unsuitable.
Eligible cargo recovered from O'Hare-related cargo facilities may require same-day onward delivery after release and pickup.
Some failed-delivery recovery scenarios may also require inside pickup or inside delivery depending on the shipment and site conditions.
Production-down or technician-parts shipments may use dedicated transportation when timing and continuity requirements are critical.
Construction material deliveries may require liftgate support where loading-dock access is unavailable or unsuitable.
Commercial white-glove transportation may overlap with inside pickup or delivery when higher-touch handling or controlled placement is required.
Time-sensitive show freight may use dedicated transportation when event schedules or handling requirements make shared routing unsuitable.
Eligible medical and healthcare-related shipments may require same-day courier transportation within Royal Courier's supported service scope.
